audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer read 'Skill' on rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 while win[0..6] and the packet chart read Taliyah, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia on those rows.
audit.why: Content layer and packet agree with each other and with the lane's shape — Taliyah's 1000-range Q owns level 1, Cassiopeia's DPS owns levels 4+ at a 50% overall win rate.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side to Taliyah; phases[3].side, phases[4].side and phases[6].side to Cassiopeia, with each row's why rewritten to argue that verdict. win[N] already matched, so no content-layer chart edit was needed.

audit.why: Spikes track Taliyah's level 3-5 combo, Weaver's Wall at 6 (180s at rank 1), Cassiopeia's first item and full build.
audit.corrected: Left spikes[] as written; the ability names in them are correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Unraveled Earth only stuns enemies who dash through it or are knocked through it. Cassiopeia has no dash, so the mines can only stun her via a Seismic Shove displacement. The page also sold Miasma's grounding as the anti-dive answer against a champion whose lane mobility is passive wall Move Speed.
audit.why: Riot text on E: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Riot text on P: 'Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.'
audit.corrected: Stated that dodging Seismic Shove (14s at rank 1, 8s at rank 5) disarms her only stun, and recast Miasma as a slow that buys the walk-up rather than an anti-dash tool.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Seismic Shove 14s to 8s, Threaded Volley 7s to 3s, Weaver's Wall 180s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eleven fields called Taliyah 'he/his/him', two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes, and the wave section described a roaming assassin.
audit.why: lintFindings MISGENDER and COPY_PASTE_BLEED; Taliyah is female per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her, bullet bodies matched to their titles, and the worst-wave clause grounded in her 1000-range Q.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Petrifying Gaze has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.

Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Taliyah off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the walk-up: poison her on every last-hit, and when your jungler arrives, Miasma's slow pins her off the wall speed she escapes on.

edits.before: If Taliyah takes first blood, tighten up: Seismic Shove is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through grounded peel.

notes: Taliyah is female — eleven misgendered fields fixed. Chart: the full layer disagreed with both win[N] and the packet on rows 0, 3, 4 and 6, so I moved the full sides to match the content layer and rewrote those whys; no win[N] edit was needed because the content layer was already right. Two packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Her Weaver's Wall' (spikes[1]) and 'Save Petrifying Gaze' (wants.you[2]) are both the correct ability names. Derived-flag misfires in the kit file, reported not used: Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove are tagged 'grounding' but Riot's text gives them a slow and a displacement respectively, and Unraveled Earth is tagged 'dash' when it is a stationary minefield. Not verifiable from the kit and therefore not written: whether Miasma's grounding prevents Taliyah surfing her own Weaver's Wall.
